svg.aria-label: Bonus stage: Nokia Snake eating a year of GitHub contributions
svg.title: Bonus stage: Nokia Snake eating a year of GitHub contributions
svg.desc: Chapter five, bonus stage. A Nokia 3310 plays Snake on the contribution calendar. The snake grows one segment per contribution day and eats all 94 of them, planning its route on a Hamiltonian cycle so it can never trap itself.
